transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I suppose I'm here because... well, things have just felt different lately. It's like the part of me that used to reach out to people, or... take pleasure in things, has just gone very quiet. 

I used to care a lot about my work, and I liked yoga, going to galleries, even just journaling... but lately, I don't know. I'm mostly just moving through my obligations. I guess that's what finally brought me in.
Have you noticed a decrease in your interest or pleasure in activities like your work, yoga, or going to galleries?
Yes... um, like I just said. It's all just gone quiet. I don't really get anything out of work, or yoga, or... any of it anymore. I'm mostly just getting through my obligations.
How long have you been feeling this way?

Um... about eight months, I suppose. We... took an older relative into our apartment around then. I guess that's when this whole shift started... with my work, and how I'm thinking and connecting with people. Just... since then.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty, maybe even blaming yourself for things that aren't your fault?
No, not really. I don't... I don't feel guilty. Just... quiet, like I said.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or maybe feeling restless and unable to sit still?
Um... no. I haven't noticed anything like that. I'm not restless or... moving slowly. Just normal, I guess.
Have you noticed a loss of energy or feeling fatigued lately, even if you're not doing much?
I don't... no. My energy is fine. I haven't really noticed being unusually tired or anything.
Have you felt down or depressed most days, for most of the day, since this shift began?
I don't think so. I haven't really felt... depressed. Just kind of the same, I suppose.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to think clearly, concentrate, or make decisions lately?
Um... no. I haven't really had any trouble with that. I can focus just fine, and... making decisions hasn't been an issue.
Have you experienced a depressed mood for most of the day, more days than not, for at least the past 2 years?
No... not really. I don't think so. I haven't been feeling depressed like that.
Have you noticed that activities you used to enjoy, like yoga or going to galleries, no longer feel rewarding or pleasurable to you?

I suppose so, yes. That's... actually what finally brought me in. It just feels like the part of me that used to reach out to people, or find pleasure in my work... or the yoga and galleries... it’s just gone very quiet. Even my journaling. I'm mostly just... moving through obligations right now.
Would you say that you’ve lost interest or pleasure in most activities, even ones you used to enjoy, for most of the time over the past several months?
I mean... yes. Like I just said, I'm mostly just going through the motions. I haven't really kept track of exactly how many months it's been, but... yeah. I suppose so.
Have you experienced a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy for most of the day, more days than not, for the past two years?
No... not two years. Like I said, it's really just been... recently. The last few months, maybe. Not years.
Have you felt down or experienced a depressed mood for most of the day, even when there wasn’t anything specific causing it?
I don't think so. I haven't really felt down or sad... it's just more like I said, things are just quiet. Empty, maybe, but not sad.
Would you say that your loss of pleasure or interest in activities has been going on steadily for the past two years, or has it been more recent than that?
I... I thought I just said. It's more recent. Definitely not two years.
Have you had days where you felt down or depressed most of the day, even when there wasn't anything specific happening to cause it?
I... didn't you just ask me that? No. I haven't been depressed. It's just... like I said a minute ago. Just quiet.
Would you say that your loss of pleasure or interest in activities has been going on steadily for the past two years, or has it been more recent than that?

You... you just asked me that, too. Like I said, it hasn't been two years. It's been about eight months. Since we took my older relative into our apartment. That's when this whole change with... how I'm thinking, and working, and connecting with people... that's when it started.
Have you experienced a depressed mood for most of the day, more days than not, for at least the past 2 years?
I... I feel like you're just asking me the exact same thing again. No. Like I already said... I haven't been depressed. And it definitely hasn't been two years.
Have you experienced a low, sad, or empty mood for most of the day, on most days, since this change began?
I don't... I really don't understand why we keep going over this. No. I'm not sad. I'm not empty. I'm just... quiet. Like I said.
Have you experienced a loss of pleasure or interest in most activities for most of the day, more days than not, over the past two years?
I... I don't have a different answer for you. Are you just reading off a list? No. Not two years. Just... no.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt down or lost interest in almost all activities so much that it was hard to keep up with even basic responsibilities?
No. I manage my responsibilities just fine. I haven't... I haven't had a period like that.
